value.title: A Narrow Escape
value.synopsis: A genius youth, Fan Lingxiao, is betrayed by his spirit beast and reborn in disgrace-only to awaken as a notorious rogue.

value.title: Falling Apart
value.synopsis: The former sect leader returns to Lingxiao Pavilion, only to find it expelled and abandoned by the alliance.

value.title: Rallying Again
value.synopsis: With the sect on the brink, Fan Lingxiao seeks spirit beasts for everyone-only to fall into a deadly trap.

value.title: Identity Exposed
value.synopsis: To save their own, old grudges are set aside as the group raids Youyou Hall, while Fan Lingxiao faces an identity crisis.

value.title: Brothers at War
value.synopsis: Fan Lingxiao allies with Su Muchuan, but the trials force him to fight his former brother, Duan Ye.

value.title: The Stronger the Foe, the Stronger We Rise
value.synopsis: The team is split into solo battles until overlooked Cheng Xi turns the tide with a last-second counterattack.

value.title: Arriva un nemico formidabile
value.synopsis: Yue Tang incontra un trio di ragazze un po' frivole e ha facilmente la meglio su di loro. Scoprirà che il quarto membro del loro gruppo è stato rapito da un membro del perfido Culto Xiegu che le sta minacciando di toglierle la vita. Yue deciderà quindi di aiutarle.

value.title: Punching Above Our Weight
value.synopsis: Fan Lingxiao is mocked by his ex, yet Jiang Rou’er helps her “old love” escape a deadly bind.

value.title: Brothers United
value.synopsis: Fan Lingxiao leads Lingxiao Pavilion into a united stand against the ruthless Ghost Blade Sect.

value.title: Duan Ye Returns
value.synopsis: Former brothers meet on the battlefield-will Duan Ye show mercy to Fan Lingxiao?

value.title: Life or Death
value.synopsis: Zizai Sect launches a fatal strike on Lingxiao Pavilion, leaving everyone on the edge of death.

value.title: An All-Out Strike
value.synopsis: Backed into a corner, Fan Lingxiao makes his final stand-he must win at all costs.
